summary.zh-TW: 接收 NEC 紅外線遙控器按鍵與按下／放開事件。
summary.en: Receive NEC infrared remote keys and press/release events.

mangolite-pico2w.zh-TW: MangoLite 為板載固定 GP22 IR，不由 ir_sensor 選配開關決定是否存在。
mangolite-pico2w.en: MangoLite has fixed onboard IR on GP22; the optional ir_sensor switch is not its availability gate.

mangox2-pico.zh-TW: MangoX2 為選配外接 IR，Pin 由 ir_sensor_pin 決定。
mangox2-pico.en: MangoX2 IR is an optional external receiver configured by ir_sensor_pin.

summary.zh-TW: 控制左右馬達、前後移動、轉向與 Tank Drive。

m.stop()
